articles.summary: Recognition marks second consecutive year Amneal has been named a BioSpace Best Place to Work BRIDGEWATER, N.J., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMRX) (“Amneal” or the “Company”) today announced that it has been named a BioSpace 2027 Best Place to Work, earning the No.1 ranking among large employers in the life sciences industry. The recognition marks the second consecutive year Amneal has been named to BioSpace’s Best Places to Work list, rising from the No.4 ranking among large employers last year. “We are incredibly proud to be recognized as the No.1 Best Place to Work among large employers by BioSpace,” said Nikita Shah, Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer of Amneal. “This recognition belongs to our people and reflects the strong culture they help shape every day. articles.summary: European Commission approval follows UK MHRA authorization of Adcomfo in March 2026 U.S. application for proposed biosimilar of XOLAIR® currently under review BRIDGEWATER, N.J., Nov. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMRX) (“Amneal” or the “Company”) today announced that the European Commission (EC) has granted marketing authorization for Adcomfo ® (omalizumab), a biosimilar to XOLAIR ® . Adcomfo, also known as ADL-018/AVT23, was developed by Kashiv BioSciences LLC in collaboration with Alvotech. Amneal acquired Kashiv in August 2026. The European Commission approval follows the positive opinion issued by the European Medicines Agency’s (EMA) Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use (CHMP) in September 2026. Separately, Adcomfo received authorization from the UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) in March 2026. Together, these approvals represent important regulatory milestones for the program and expand Adcomfo’s reach
articles.title: Amneal Announces European Approval of Adcomfo® (Omalizumab), a Biosimilar to XOLAIR®
